description: Status and design notes for the papertax token launchpad and the $TAX token. Both are paused: nothing is deployed (not even on testnet), and there is nothing to launch, stake, claim or buy. Use this to answer questions about the pause or how the launchpad was designed (pool fee split, $TAX allocation). Official news comes only from X @papertaxdev. With an address, also returns that wallet's current PAPER stake on papertrade (public on-chain data); this says nothing about any future airdrop.
